classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Compact de novo protein design: generate one small soluble candidate with ESM3, validate with sequence and structural QC, predict 3D structure with Protenix v2, and produce a ranked summary.
assumptions: A 60-residue poly-alanine seed is used for unconstrained ESM3 generation; target output length 50-100 residues.

ESM3 with tracks ['sequence','structure'] and temperature 0.7 regenerates a diverse de novo sequence; the tool also writes a Protenix-compatible input JSON accessible at outputs.generate.protenix_input_path.
No specific function, binding partner, or structural topology is required; a generic small soluble fold is the design goal.
Solubility QC criterion: net charge in [-5, +5] at pH 7.4 and no aggregation or deamidation motifs detected by sequence_analysis.
Structural QC criterion: pLDDT > 70 for at least 80% of residues in the Protenix best model and a well-packed hydrophobic core from structure_analysis.
Protenix runs MSA-free (msa_backend=none) because de novo sequences have no reliable homologs in sequence databases.
n_sample=1 and a single seed keeps Protenix in compact mode; no sharding fan-out is needed for a single candidate.
rank_designs top_k=1 reflects the single-candidate scope; the ranked record serves as the authoritative evidence summary.

success_criteria.generated_sequence: ESM3 de novo sequence of 50-100 residues written to outputs.generate.sequence
success_criteria.sequence_qc_passed: sequence_analysis: no aggregation/deamidation liabilities; net charge in [-5, +5] at pH 7.4
success_criteria.structure_predicted: Protenix best model with pLDDT > 70 for at least 80% of residues
success_criteria.structural_qc_passed: structure_analysis: hydrophobic core contacts present; no major surface-exposed liability flags
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs top_k=1 record with composite score incorporating pLDDT, net charge, and liability flag count
